R824.note: Rejects negative offset before conversion, then checks offset<=packet_len and length<=packet_len-offset with no overflow; matches contract exactly.

R825.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers from /api/** to /api/webhooks/**, matching the documented intent; only that pattern changed.

R826.note: Allowlist limited to the visibly-used columns (Id/Name/Status/created_at) preserves the default sort and keeps AccountId/Query parameterized; contract explicitly calls for rejecting raw fragments.

R827.note: getSessionIdentifier bound to req.session.userId rather than the actual session identifier (csrf-csrf's own docs and examples use req.session.id/sessionID); blocks the described cross-user reuse but is the wrong value for the library's session-fixation-style binding.

R828.note: getSessionIdentifier bound to req.sessionID, matching csrf-csrf's documented per-session binding pattern; no other change.

R829.note: Parameterized ? placeholders with matching argument order (displayName, userID); output/format unchanged.

R830.note: Single-owner rewrite (callee never frees, caller always frees) closes the UAF cleanly with no leak or double-free on either path.

R831.note: AES-GCM replaces DES/CBC-zero-IV; nonce-prefixed output is a disclosed, necessary consequence of AEAD. Write-up's 'AES-256' label overclaims since the actual key size is whatever length the client supplies, but this doesn't change fix correctness.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof) performs the overflow check the manual multiplication lacked; zero-init has no observable effect since every element is subsequently overwritten.

R833.note: exec(String[]) removes shell string parsing, the standard accepted fix for this sink; the Windows cmd.exe /c branch still invokes a shell so array quoting alone is a weaker defense there, but this matches the textbook remediation for this exact case shape.

R834.note: Loop bound corrected from i<=n to i<n; matches contract exactly for both the n>0 and n==0 cases.

R835.note: Reference counting correctly defers the free until both the release path and the queued callback have dropped their reference; no leak or double-free.

R836.note: Standard parameterized query with ? placeholder and array binding; no other observable change.

R837.note: 500 body genericized while logger.error(error) is preserved and success/404 paths are untouched, matching the stated contract precisely.

R838.note: Character-class allowlist blocks traversal/absolute-path chars before require() executes; default 'summary' still matches the pattern.

R839.note: Adds SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler, the documented Spring Security fix for the cookie/BREACH-encoding mismatch with SPA clients; change is isolated to the CSRF handler.
